title: IRANIAN EXPANSION Андорра REGIONAL CONFLICT
text: The Emirate of Tyuftel has launched a massive, multi-front offensive, capturing **Khartoum**, **North Darfur**, and **Blue Nile** in Sudan, alongside **Palestine**, parts of **Pakistan**, and the **Northeast** of South Sudan. These victories have come at a heavy cost in casualties and infrastructure, further destabilizing the region and triggering massive waves of refugees. The **Coalition against the Emirate of Tyuftel** continues to mobilize, with India actively deploying troops to support its allies against Iranian aggression.

title: US CONSOLIDATION Андорра EUROPEAN CAMPAIGN
text: The United States has completed its military operations in the British Isles by capturing the **Southwest** of Ireland and the **Isle of Man**, effectively ending the sovereignty of the resistance there. With the fall of these territories, the US has signaled a shift toward economic consolidation, launching full-scale industrial and financial programs to boost national stability and growth after months of intense military mobilization.

title: SOUTH AFRICAN OFFENSIVE IN AFRICA
text: The South African Republic has launched a sweeping military campaign, successfully seizing territory in **Namibia**, **Tanzania**, and **Burundi**. Despite fierce partisan resistance in occupied zones, Pretoria's forces have pushed forward, significantly expanding their control across the continent. However, the rapid expansion has led to logistical strains and an influx of refugees, impacting the stability of neighboring states.

title: ITALIAN DIPLOMATIC Андорра ECONOMIC INTEGRATION
text: The Fourth Macaroni Rome has achieved a significant diplomatic milestone by finalizing the **peaceful union with Serbia**, integrating its regions and population into the state. Italy continues to aggressively pursue regional economic stability, signing new trade agreements with neighboring states like **Bolivia**, **Colombia**, **Venezuela**, and **Argentina**, further cementing its influence as a regional economic hub.

title: MEANWHILE IN THE WORLD
text: Global tension remains at a critical **100**, with commodity markets reacting to the ongoing wars—cobalt prices have spiked due to the fighting in the Congo. A political scandal in the **Sultanate of Kosovo** has dropped its national stability, while **Argentina** faces economic distress following a severe drought in its southern regions. Elsewhere, **Japan** is focusing on internal economic stimulation and technology-driven development.
